rules.interaction: Statewide; no local deposit rules known from this text.

all.unavailable: owner-occupied premises where tenant has not given 30 days written notice invoking the act

rules.exemptions: Act does not apply to owner-occupied premises with not more than two rental units unless the tenant gives 30 days written notice (N.J.S.A. 46:8-26)
rules.coverage_conditions: Rental of real property used for dwelling purposes
rules.title: NJ security deposit limit
rules.requirement: A landlord may not require more than 1.5 times one month's rent as a security deposit, and any annual top-up may not exceed 10 percent of the current deposit.
rules.key_value: 1.5 months' rent; annual increase max 10% of deposit
rules.quoted_span: An owner or lessee may not require more than a sum equal to 1 1/2 times 1 month's rental according to the terms of contract, lease, or agreement

notes: Effective_date '2003' is the year of the amendment (L.2003 c.188 s.5) that appears in the history line; exact date not in text. The exemption in exempt_if comes from 46:8-26 (X013), not this page.
